Mouse Tracking Go/No-Go Study
cognitive controlgo / no-govisualgermanbehavioral2 sessions

A mouse-tracking go/no-go paradigm with a dynamic start that captures response inhibition during ongoing movement execution, evaluated for test-retest reliability of behavioral and kinematic stopping measures across two sessions.

Participants: 23
Age: 23.2 ± 3.7 years
Male / Female: 0/0
